formal_statement:

    ∀ (x d : ℝ) (a₁ a₂ a₃ : ℝ) (n : ℕ), 
    a₁ = 2*x - 3 → 
    a₂ = 5*x - 11 → 
    a₃ = 3*x + 1 → 
    a₂ - a₁ = d → 
    a₃ - a₂ = d → 
    n > 0 → 
    (∃ (seq : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ k, seq (k + 1) = seq k + d) ∧ seq 0 = a₁ ∧ seq (n - 1) = 2009) → 
    n = 502 := sorry
